mundoObj.boton.ayuda: Edit obstacles, mazes and teleporters on the world. Every change is recorded in the run and replicas repeat it on the same cycle.
mundoObj.ancho: Width of new shapes (fraction of the field)
mundoObj.alto: Height of new shapes (fraction of the field)
mundoObj.tamano.ayuda: Width × height of new shapes, as fractions of the field (0.01 to 1).
mundoObj.tamano.invalido: Size goes from 0.01 to 1 (fraction of the field).
mundoObj.forma.ayuda: One new shape of that size, at a random place.
mundoObj.formas10.ayuda: Ten new shapes of that size, at random places.
mundoObj.borrar10.ayuda: Deletes ten shapes picked at random.
mundoObj.laberinto.ayuda: Adds the shapes of a maze to the field.
mundoObj.laberinto.h.ayuda: A row of vertical walls, each with a random gap: travel from left to right.
mundoObj.laberinto.v.ayuda: Stacked horizontal walls, each with a random gap: travel from top to bottom.
mundoObj.laberinto.spiral.ayuda: A corridor spiralling into the centre of the field.
mundoObj.laberinto.checker.ayuda: Blocks in a checkerboard, separated by the corridor (the wall is not used).
mundoObj.laberinto.polar.ayuda: Ice floes drifting across the field (turns shape movement on; corridor and wall are not used).
mundoObj.laberinto.trash.ayuda: Two moving walls that compact whatever is between them (corridor and wall are not used).
mundoObj.pasillo.ayuda: Corridor width, in field units (horizontal, vertical, spiral and checkerboard).
mundoObj.muro.ayuda: Wall thickness, in field units (horizontal, vertical and spiral).
mundoObj.laberinto.invalido: Corridor and wall: whole numbers greater than 0.
mundoObj.teleporter.ayuda: A new teleporter at a random place: bots that enter it come out elsewhere in the field.
mundoObj.teleporter.tope: There are already 10 teleporters, the maximum.
mundoObj.borrar.ayuda: Delete mode: clicking a shape or a teleporter removes it. Esc to leave.
mundoObj.confirmar.formas: Delete all the shapes in the world ({n})?
mundoObj.confirmar.teleporters: Delete all the teleporters in the world ({n})?
mundoObj.guardar.ayuda: The current objects become the run's scenario objects, as orders (a new sim places them again at random with its seed), and Experiment shows them.
mundoObj.guardar.sinEscenario: This run did not come from a scenario (a .dbsim opened from a file or the test sim): there is no scenario to save to.
mundoObj.modoBorrar: Delete mode: click a shape or a teleporter to remove it. With the world focused: N and Shift+N step through the objects, Delete removes the highlighted one and Esc leaves.
mundoObj.aviso.guardado.uno: Saved to the scenario: {n} object order. Experiment already shows it.
mundoObj.aviso.guardado.otros: Saved to the scenario: {n} object orders. Experiment already shows them.
mundoObj.aviso.vacio: Saved: the scenario is left without obstacles or teleporters.
mundoObj.aviso.aproximado.uno: Saved to the scenario: {n} object order. Shapes deleted one by one or at random have no equivalent order: a new sim creates them again.
mundoObj.aviso.aproximado.otros: Saved to the scenario: {n} object orders. Shapes deleted one by one or at random have no equivalent order: a new sim creates them again.
mundoObj.aviso.error: The change could not be applied to the world.
